# .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md

# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary

Describe:

* What changed
* Why it changed
* Related issue

---

## Type

* [ ] Feature
* [ ] Bug Fix
* [ ] Refactor
* [ ] Documentation
* [ ] Security
* [ ] Performance

---

## Verification

* [ ] Project builds successfully
* [ ] ESLint passes
* [ ] TypeScript passes
* [ ] Unit tests pass
* [ ] Playwright tests pass
* [ ] No console errors

---

## Security

* [ ] RLS verified
* [ ] Permissions checked
* [ ] No secrets exposed
* [ ] Inputs validated
* [ ] Sensitive data sanitized

---

## UI

* [ ] Responsive
* [ ] Accessible
* [ ] Loading states
* [ ] Empty states
* [ ] Error states
* [ ] Dark mode verified

---

## Documentation

* [ ] AGENTS.md updated (if required)
* [ ] Relevant docs updated
* [ ] Changelog updated

---

## Final Review

* [ ] No dead code
* [ ] No duplicate logic
* [ ] No unused imports
* [ ] Code follows Design System
* [ ] Ready for production

---

## Reviewer Notes

List anything reviewers should pay special attention to.

---

## Principle

> A Pull Request is ready only when it is secure, tested, documented, and maintainable—not merely functional.
